Scores live on the AER-1 conformance challenge, so the table stays in one place:

https://github.com/zambodotdev/aer-1/issues/4

Post your verifier, your score out of 146, and your environment there. Use this template only if your run hit a problem with the kit itself (a crash, a wrong count, a digest mismatch): describe the run and paste its final line.
